items.title: A finite type module on a quasi-compact space which is a colimit of a directed system is reached at some stage
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a module of finite type on a quasi-compact ringed space which is the colimit of a directed system of modules is already the image of some stage, and is equal to some stage when the transition maps are injective (author lemma at source lines 1143-1156, label lemma-finite-type-quasi-compact-colimit). The proof (source lines 1158-1172) lifts finitely many local generators of the colimit to stages of the system, uses quasi-compactness to pass to a finite covering, and then takes an index above all the stages reached (proof lines 1159-1171). The combination of local lifting with quasi-compactness is the content. H2.
